projects.title: Color16
projects.text: Dot was a personal AI agent I built at New Computer, the company I co-founded. At its core was one of the first narrative long-term memory systems, designed to help people remember, organize, and navigate their lives.
credits: Sam Whitmore (co-founder and CEO), Jason Yuan; Daniel Stratton, Devin Fan, Luca Beetz, Julian Kelly, Alex Widua, Louis Harboe, Max Kuwertz, Joe Tsao

projects.title: Hivemind
projects.text: Hivemind is a social AI that has one-on-one conversations with many people at once. It exists to answer the universal human question: “What do people really think about ___?” In addition to being its founder, I lead the harness and cognitive/memory design for Hivemind.
credits: Jason Yuan; Harsh Patel (logomark), Max Kuwertz (images)

projects.title: MakeSpace
projects.text: MakeSpace was a multiplayer spatial browser I co-created with Aza Raskin as a pandemic project. It let people browse, talk, move, and create together on a shared canvas. Its interaction model directly influenced the creation of products like FigJam.

editableWords.name: Dragonlee
bio: I’m a designer with over a decade of experience in product design, brand design, and team leadership.
I believe in finding order in complexity and richness in simplicity. Starting with business strategy, I turn ideas about the future into clear, practical design.

At Alibaba, I led design for Quark’s core product experience. At OPPO, my work spanned design planning for ColorOS releases, visual direction, and AI product experiences. I’ve also led brand refreshes and defined experience standards for core businesses.
I’m now exploring design workflows powered by AI to help teams collaborate more effectively, leaving more room for judgment and creativity.
I’ve served as a judge at the UXPA Design Summit and a speaker at IXDC. I’ve received a Red Dot Award and hold multiple design patents.
